controls.name: C-14d
controls.query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-13T09:27:39.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-13T10:27:39.000Z"
| WHERE host.ip == "172.18.0.24"
| STATS first_seen = MIN(@timestamp), last_seen = MAX(@timestamp)
    BY host.name
| SORT last_seen DESC
| LIMIT 10
